title: Parting with Miaoyi
summary: An Miaoyi dances for Ye Fan and tells him flowers bloom again: however many lifetimes pass, they will meet again, and if he reaches the Dao he should look near the flower he once knew. Ye Fan promises to walk the road of glory in this life and to keep that promise across ten or a hundred lifetimes. After she leaves, the Buddhist remnant will she left behind urges him to give up desire and take refuge in the Buddha, attacking with a Buddhist bell and the Om syllable. Ye Fan refuses help, turns the Battle Saint method (the 'Dou' secret) into his own Om syllable and breaks it, and the remnant fades. After Li Tian pesters him, Ye Fan goes deeper to the birthplace of the North Pole Immortal Light, the last place Tu Fei could be. A dangerous force field there is said to be survivable only by Saints, but Ye Fan finds Tu Fei and ignores Li Tian's warnings to go in.
